breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes the slope at the free end using theta = PL^2 / (2EI), which is non-zero. It does not set the free-end rotation to zero, correctly reflecting that a cantilever's free end rotates under an end point load.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use the bending moment distribution M(x) = P(L − x), which varies linearly from PL at the fixed end to zero at the free end,' correctly replacing the erroneous constant moment PL with the proper linearly varying moment distribution. The deflection formula delta = PL^3 / (3EI) also reflects integration of the correct moment distribution.
